source: closed-form from Buildings CDL.Reals.Sources.Sin.mo source equation; independent re-derivation
compare_regime: aligned finite-Real tolerance for transcendental outputs; Inf/NaN by IEEE class
input: amplitude=2, freqHz=0.25, phase=pi/2, offset=0.5, startTime=1; before start, observable start boundary, phase plumbing, and period samples
reference_rule: y = offset + (if time < startTime then 0 else amplitude*sin(2*pi*freqHz*(time-startTime)+phase)); Buildings Reals/Sources/Sin.mo, deterministic libm 0.2.16
math_library: libm 0.2.16, default-features=false, pure Rust deterministic math
format: Modelica CombiTimeTable CSV (_spec/07 §9); signal CSV is time+one output; reference.csv is time+inputs+all outputs; ryu shortest-round-trip f64
